responsibility: This header declares the public RTL shrink-wrapping interfaces used by the backend prologue/epilogue machinery. It exposes the predicate for whether an insn requires a stack frame, the main and separate-component shrink-wrapping entry points, and the SHRINK_WRAPPING_ENABLED policy macro that ties the optimization to the user flag and target simple-return capability.
same_name_distinction: This .h file is the small public interface for shrink-wrapping, declaring the externally used predicates and entry points and the SHRINK_WRAPPING_ENABLED policy macro; gcc/shrink-wrap.cc contains the optimization engine and placement logic.
